# mimecast_dmarc_policy_preset (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast DMARC Analyzer DMARC policy preset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dmarc_policy_preset" "example" {
  name             = "tf-example-policy"
  description      = "Managed by Terraform"
  version          = "DMARC1"
  policy           = "none"
  subdomain_policy = "none"
  dkim_alignment   = "r"
  spf_alignment    = "r"
  percentage       = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy-preset name.
- `policy` (String) DMARC policy action.
- `version` (String) DMARC definition version, such as DMARC1.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Policy-preset description.
- `dkim_alignment` (String) DKIM alignment mode.
- `failure_report_format` (String) DMARC failure report format.
- `failure_reporting_options` (String) Colon-delimited DMARC failure reporting options.
- `percentage` (Number) Percentage of messages to which the policy applies.
- `report_interval` (Number) Aggregate report interval in seconds.
- `rua_addresses` (Set of String, Sensitive) Aggregate-report recipient addresses.
- `ruf_addresses` (Set of String, Sensitive) Forensic-report recipient addresses.
- `spf_alignment` (String) SPF alignment mode.
- `subdomain_policy` (String) DMARC subdomain policy action.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) DMARC Analyzer policy-preset ID.
- `is_default_policy` (Boolean) Whether this is the account default policy preset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dmarc_policy_preset.example policy-preset-id
```
